name: interccom
description: One voice for all your Claude Code sessions: hear conclusions and questions, talk back hands-free.

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Your ElevenLabs API key, needed only for the elevenlabs engines. Falls back to the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY environment variable.

tts_model.title: ElevenLabs model
tts_model.description: TTS model; flash is the lowest latency.

stt_language.title: Speech language
stt_language.description: Language code for transcription (en, hr, ...), or auto to detect.

listen_mode.title: Listening mode
listen_mode.description: always: everything you say is sent. wake: only speech starting with "hey Claude". off: no mic.

muted.title: Muted
muted.description: Keep the speak tool but play nothing.

tts_engine.title: Speech engine (talking)
tts_engine.description: elevenlabs: cloud. local: an OpenAI-compatible speech server you run (Kokoro-FastAPI, Speaches, LocalAI). command: a program such as Piper.

stt_engine.title: Speech engine (listening)
stt_engine.description: elevenlabs: cloud (Scribe). local: an OpenAI-compatible transcription server you run (Speaches/faster-whisper, whisper.cpp server, LocalAI). command: a program such as whisper-cli.

local_tts_url.title: Local TTS server URL
local_tts_url.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible server, ending in /v1.

local_tts_model.title: Local TTS model
local_tts_model.description: Model name the local server expects.

local_tts_voice.title: Local TTS voice
local_tts_voice.description: Voice name the local server expects.

local_stt_url.title: Local STT server URL
local_stt_url.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible server, ending in /v1.

local_stt_model.title: Local STT model
local_stt_model.description: Model name the local server expects.

tts_command.title: TTS command
tts_command.description: For tts_engine command. Text arrives on stdin; write audio to {out}. Example: piper --model C:\voices\en_US-amy-medium.onnx --output_file {out}

stt_command.title: STT command
stt_command.description: For stt_engine command. {in} is a 16 kHz WAV; print the transcript. Example: whisper-cli -m C:\models\ggml-base.en.bin -f {in} -nt -np

autonomy.title: Coordinator autonomy
autonomy.description: What the coordinator may decide on its own. relay: only pass things on and ask you. routine: also answer routine questions. full: decide like a careful senior engineer. All three still ask about anything destructive or outward-facing.

autonomy_rules.title: Coordinator rules
autonomy_rules.description: Your own rules for the coordinator, in plain words, e.g. "never approve database migrations". The more restrictive rule wins.
